Final SQL / answer

WITH player_stint_highs AS (
    SELECT
        b.player_id,
        MAX(b.g) AS games_played,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.r, '')) AS runs,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.h, '')) AS hits,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.hr, '')) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting AS b
    GROUP BY b.player_id
),
category_highs AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(games_played) AS games_played,
        MAX(runs) AS runs,
        MAX(hits) AS hits,
        MAX(home_runs) AS home_runs
    FROM player_stint_highs
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category_order, 'Games played' AS statistic, s.player_id, s.games_played AS score
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.games_played = c.games_played

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 2, 'Runs', s.player_id, s.runs
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.runs = c.runs

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 3, 'Hits', s.player_id, s.hits
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.hits = c.hits

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 4, 'Home runs', s.player_id, s.home_runs
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.home_runs = c.home_runs
)
SELECT l.statistic, p.name_given, l.score
FROM leaders AS l
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY l.category_order, p.name_given, l.player_id
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH maxima AS (
    SELECT MAX(g) AS games_played,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(r) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN r END) AS runs,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(h) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN h END) AS hits,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(hr) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN hr END) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT 1 AS stat_order, 'Games played' AS statistic, b.player_id, b.g AS score_value
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.g = m.games_played
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Runs', b.player_id, b.r
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.r = m.runs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Hits', b.player_id, b.h
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.h = m.hits
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Home runs', b.player_id, b.hr
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.hr = m.home_runs
)
SELECT p.name_given, l.statistic, l.score_value
FROM leaders AS l
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY l.stat_order, p.name_given, l.player_id
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH role_rank AS (
    SELECT
        pm.player_id,
        pm.role,
        SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id) AS total_matches_played,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pm.player_id
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pm.role
        ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match AS pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.striker,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored,
        CASE
            WHEN w.kind_out IN (
                'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS wicket_credited
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s
        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w
        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT
        striker AS player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY striker, match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
        MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
        SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT
        bowler AS player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(wicket_credited) AS wickets_taken,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(wickets_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets_taken,
        6.0 * SUM(runs_conceded) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)
            / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,
        wickets_taken || '-' || runs_conceded AS best_bowling_performance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_id
            ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_conceded, match_id
        ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
)
SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    r.role AS most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(r.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
    1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
    b.highest_score,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
    COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
    100.0 * b.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
    COALESCE(c.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
    c.economy_rate,
    c.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN role_rank AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS c ON c.player_id = p.player_id AND c.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT -1

    "id": "item_11",
    "type": "mcp_tool_call",
    "server": "lang2sql",
    "tool": "run_sql",
    "arguments": {
      "sql": "WITH role_rank AS (\n    SELECT\n        pm.player_id,\n        pm.role,\n        SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id) AS total_matches_played,\n        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n            PARTITION BY pm.player_id\n            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pm.role\n        ) AS role_rank\n    FROM main.player_match AS pm\n    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role\n),\ndeliveries AS (\n    SELECT\n        b.match_id,\n        b.striker,\n        b.bowler,\n        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored,\n        CASE\n            WHEN w.kind_out IN (\n                'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'\n            ) THEN 1\n            ELSE 0\n        END AS wicket_credited\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s\n        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w\n        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n),\nbatting_by_match AS (\n    SELECT\n        striker AS player_id,\n        match_id,\n        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored,\n        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced\n    FROM deliveries\n    GROUP BY striker, match_id\n),\nbatting_career AS (\n    SELECT\n        player_id,\n        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,\n        MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,\n        SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,\n        SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,\n        SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,\n        SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced\n    FROM batting_by_match\n    GROUP BY player_id\n),\ndismissals AS (\n    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals\n    FROM main.wicket_taken\n    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'\n    GROUP BY player_out\n),\nbowling_by_match AS (\n    SELECT\n        bowler AS player_id,\n        match_id,\n        SUM(wicket_credited) AS wickets_taken,\n        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,\n        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled\n    FROM deliveries\n    GROUP BY bowler, match_id\n),\nbowling_career AS (\n    SELECT\n        player_id,\n        SUM(wickets_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets_taken,\n        6.0 * SUM(runs_conceded) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)\n            / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,\n        wickets_taken || '-' || runs_conceded AS best_bowling_performance,\n        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n            PARTITION BY player_id\n            ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_conceded, match_id\n        ) AS performance_rank\n    FROM bowling_by_match\n)\nSELECT\n    p.player_id,\n    p.player_name,\n    r.role AS most_frequent_role,\n    p.batting_hand,\n    p.bowling_skill,\n    COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,\n    COALESCE(r.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,\n    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,\n    1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,\n    b.highest_score,\n    COALESCE(b.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,\n    COALESCE(b.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,\n    COALESCE(b.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,\n    COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,\n    100.0 * b.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,\n    COALESCE(c.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,\n    c.economy_rate,\n    c.best_bowling_performance\nFROM main.player AS p\nLEFT JOIN role_rank AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1\nLEFT JOIN batting_career AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN bowling_career AS c ON c.player_id = p.player_id AND c.performance_rank = 1\nORDER BY p.player_id\nLIMIT -1",
      "definition_check_id": "sOx6Q-lSLvUgOblgK8ts-UEB_cv_F4yLoUVsVoCw4VM"
    },

Final SQL / answer

WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           role,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,
           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played
        FROM role_counts
        WHERE role_rank = 1
        ORDER BY player_id, role
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,
           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.
           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,
           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,
           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,
           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
)
SELECT p.player_id,
       p.player_name,
       a.most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand,
       p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       bt.highest_score,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,
       bw.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

      "sql": "WITH role_counts AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           role,\n           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,\n           RANK() OVER (\n               PARTITION BY player_id\n               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC\n           ) AS role_rank\n    FROM main.player_match\n    GROUP BY player_id, role\n),\nappearances AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,\n           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played\n    FROM (\n        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played\n        FROM role_counts\n        WHERE role_rank = 1\n        ORDER BY player_id, role\n    )\n    GROUP BY player_id\n),\nbatting_by_match AS (\n    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,\n           b.match_id,\n           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,\n           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id\n),\nbatting_career AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,\n           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,\n           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,\n           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,\n           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,\n           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced\n    FROM batting_by_match\n    GROUP BY player_id\n),\ndismissals AS (\n    SELECT player_out AS player_id,\n           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals\n    FROM main.wicket_taken\n    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'\n    GROUP BY player_out\n),\nbowling_by_match AS (\n    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,\n           b.match_id,\n           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,\n           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.\n           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,\n           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (\n               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'\n           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id\n),\nbowling_career AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,\n           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,\n           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,\n           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,\n           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n               PARTITION BY player_id\n               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id\n           ) AS performance_rank\n    FROM bowling_by_match\n    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)\n)\nSELECT p.player_id,\n       p.player_name,\n       a.most_frequent_role,\n       p.batting_hand,\n       p.bowling_skill,\n       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,\n       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,\n       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,\n       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,\n       bt.highest_score,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,\n       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,\n       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,\n       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,\n       bw.best_bowling_performance\nFROM main.player AS p\nLEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1\nORDER BY p.player_id",

AS (\n    SELECT player_out AS player_id,\n           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals\n    FROM main.wicket_taken\n    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'\n    GROUP BY player_out\n),\nbowling_by_match AS extra-runs data.\n           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,\n           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (\n               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'\n           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken\n    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b\n    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)\n    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id\n),\nbowling_career AS (\n    SELECT player_id,\n           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS matches_with_100_plus,\n       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,\n       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,\n AS p\nLEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id\nLEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1\nORDER BY p.player_id\nLIMIT 1000"

Final SQL / answer

WITH lineups AS (
    SELECT match_api_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS players
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT match_api_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS players
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT l.outcome, slot.value AS player_api_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT l.match_api_id) AS match_count
    FROM lineups AS l
    JOIN json_each(l.players) AS slot
    WHERE slot.value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.outcome, slot.value
),
ranked_players AS (
    SELECT outcome, player_api_id,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank
    FROM player_totals
)
SELECT r.outcome, p.player_name
FROM ranked_players AS r
JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
WHERE r.outcome_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.outcome DESC, p.player_name
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH team_lineups AS (
    SELECT id AS match_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT id AS match_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT t.outcome,
           slot.value AS player_api_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.match_id) AS match_count
    FROM team_lineups AS t
    CROSS JOIN json_each(t.lineup) AS slot
    WHERE slot.value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.outcome, slot.value
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT outcome, player_api_id, match_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank
    FROM player_totals
)
SELECT r.outcome, p.player_name, r.match_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
WHERE r.outcome_rank = 1
ORDER BY CASE r.outcome WHEN 'Win' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.player_name
LIMIT 1000

      ],
      "sql": "WITH team_lineups AS (\n    SELECT id AS match_id,\n           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,\n           json_array(\n               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,\n               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,\n               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11\n           ) AS lineup\n    FROM main.\"Match\"\n    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal\n\n    UNION ALL\n\n    SELECT id AS match_id,\n           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,\n           json_array(\n               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,\n               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,\n               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11\n           ) AS lineup\n    FROM main.\"Match\"\n    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal\n),\nplayer_totals AS (\n    SELECT t.outcome,\n           slot.value AS player_api_id,\n           COUNT(DISTINCT t.match_id) AS match_count\n    FROM team_lineups AS t\n    CROSS JOIN json_each(t.lineup) AS slot\n    WHERE slot.value IS NOT NULL\n    GROUP BY t.outcome, slot.value\n),\nranked AS (\n    SELECT outcome, player_api_id, match_count,\n           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank\n    FROM player_totals\n)\nSELECT r.outcome, p.player_name, r.match_count\nFROM ranked AS r\nJOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id\nWHERE r.outcome_rank = 1\nORDER BY CASE r.outcome WHEN 'Win' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.player_name"

          "type": "text",

Counts refer to the executed SQL, not the source table size.\nObserved value types (displayed rows): outcome=str; player_name=str; match_count=int\noutcome | player_name | match_count\n--- | --- | ---\nWin | Cristiano Ronaldo | 199\nLoss | Gorka Iraizoz Moreno | 107\nSQL: WITH team_lineups AS (\n    SELECT id AS match_id,\n           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,\n           json_array(\n               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,\n               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,\n               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11\n           ) AS lineup\n    FROM main.\"Match\"\n    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal\n\n    UNION ALL\n\n    SELECT id AS match_id,\n           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,\n           json_array(\n               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,\n               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,\n               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11\n           ) AS lineup\n    FROM main.\"Match\"\n    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal\n),\nplayer_totals AS (\n    SELECT t.outcome,\n           slot.value AS player_api_id,\n           COUNT(DISTINCT t.match_id) AS match_count\n    FROM team_lineups AS t\n    CROSS JOIN json_each(t.lineup) AS slot\n    WHERE slot.value IS NOT NULL\n    GROUP BY t.outcome, slot.value\n),\nranked AS (\n    SELECT outcome, player_api_id, match_count,\n           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank\n    FROM player_totals\n)\nSELECT r.outcome, p.player_name, r.match_count\nFROM ranked AS r\nJOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id\nWHERE r.outcome_rank = 1\nORDER BY CASE r.outcome WHEN 'Win' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.player_name\nLIMIT 1000"

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_interest_composition AS (
    SELECT printf('%04d-%02d-01', m._year, m._month) AS month_start,
           m.interest_id,
           AVG(m.composition / NULLIF(m.index_value, 0)) AS avg_index_composition
    FROM main.interest_metrics AS m
    WHERE m._year * 100 + m._month BETWEEN 201807 AND 201908
    GROUP BY m._year, m._month, m.interest_id
),
ranked_interests AS (
    SELECT month_start,
           interest_id,
           avg_index_composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY month_start
               ORDER BY avg_index_composition DESC, interest_id
           ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_interest_composition
    WHERE avg_index_composition IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_history AS (
    SELECT r.month_start,
           i.interest_name,
           r.avg_index_composition AS max_index_composition,
           AVG(r.avg_index_composition) OVER (
               month_order ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS three_month_rolling_avg,
           LAG(i.interest_name, 1) OVER month_order AS one_month_ago_interest_name,
           LAG(r.avg_index_composition, 1) OVER month_order AS one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
           LAG(i.interest_name, 2) OVER month_order AS two_months_ago_interest_name,
           LAG(r.avg_index_composition, 2) OVER month_order AS two_months_ago_max_index_composition
    FROM ranked_interests AS r
    JOIN main.interest_map AS i ON i.id = r.interest_id
    WHERE r.month_rank = 1
    WINDOW month_order AS (ORDER BY r.month_start)
)
SELECT month_start,
       interest_name,
       max_index_composition,
       three_month_rolling_avg,
       one_month_ago_interest_name,
       one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
       two_months_ago_interest_name,
       two_months_ago_max_index_composition
FROM monthly_history
WHERE month_start >= '2018-09-01'
ORDER BY month_start
LIMIT 12

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_interest AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(PRINTF('%04d-%02d-01', m._year, m._month)) AS month_start,
        m.interest_id,
        AVG(1.0 * m.composition / NULLIF(m.index_value, 0)) AS average_composition
    FROM main.interest_metrics AS m
    WHERE m._year * 100 + m._month BETWEEN 201807 AND 201908
    GROUP BY m._year, m._month, m.interest_id
),
ranked_interest AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        interest_id,
        average_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY month_start
            ORDER BY average_composition DESC, interest_id
        ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_interest
    WHERE average_composition IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT
        r.month_start,
        i.interest_name,
        r.average_composition AS max_index_composition
    FROM ranked_interest AS r
    JOIN main.interest_map AS i ON i.id = r.interest_id
    WHERE r.month_rank = 1
),
rolling_composition AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        interest_name,
        max_index_composition,
        AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS three_month_rolling_average,
        LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS one_month_ago_interest_name,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
        LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS two_months_ago_interest_name,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS two_months_ago_max_index_composition
    FROM monthly_max
)
SELECT
    month_start,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    three_month_rolling_average,
    one_month_ago_interest_name,
    one_month_ago_max_index_composition,
    two_months_ago_interest_name,
    two_months_ago_max_index_composition
FROM rolling_composition
WHERE month_start >= '2018-09-01' AND month_start < '2019-09-01'
ORDER BY month_start
LIMIT 12

Final SQL / answer

WITH page_visits AS (
    SELECT
        path AS third_page,
        LAG(path, 1) OVER visit_order AS previous_page,
        LAG(path, 2) OVER visit_order AS second_previous_page
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    WINDOW visit_order AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid)
)
SELECT third_page, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM page_visits
WHERE previous_page = '/detail'
  AND second_previous_page = '/detail'
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY visit_count DESC, third_page DESC
LIMIT 3

Final SQL / answer

WITH visits AS (
    SELECT path,
           LEAD(path, 1) OVER visit_order AS second_page,
           LEAD(path, 2) OVER visit_order AS third_page
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    WINDOW visit_order AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid)
)
SELECT third_page, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM visits
WHERE path = '/detail'
  AND second_page = '/detail'
  AND third_page IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY visit_count DESC, third_page DESC
LIMIT 3

Final SQL / answer

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        st.StudLastName,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY ss.Grade DESC) AS rank_fraction
    FROM main.Student_Schedules AS ss
    JOIN main.Students AS st ON st.StudentID = ss.StudentID
    JOIN main.Classes AS c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
    JOIN main.Subjects AS sub ON sub.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND sub.CategoryID = 'ENG'
)
SELECT
    StudLastName,
    CASE
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.20 THEN 'First'
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.40 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.60 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.80 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_fraction, StudLastName
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH ranked_grades AS (
    SELECT
        st.StudLastName,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY ss.Grade DESC) AS grade_share
    FROM Student_Schedules AS ss
    JOIN Students AS st ON st.StudentID = ss.StudentID
    JOIN Classes AS c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects AS sub ON sub.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND sub.CategoryID = 'ENG'
)
SELECT
    StudLastName,
    CASE
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.20 THEN 'First'
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.40 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.60 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN grade_share <= 0.80 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
FROM ranked_grades
ORDER BY grade_share, StudLastName
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.delivery_order_id
    FROM deliveries AS d
    WHERE d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
),
store_totals AS (
    SELECT
        s.store_id,
        s.store_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(d.delivery_order_id) AS delivered_orders
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    LEFT JOIN delivered_orders AS d ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
)
SELECT
    store_name,
    total_orders,
    1.0 * delivered_orders / total_orders AS delivered_order_ratio
FROM store_totals
WHERE total_orders = (SELECT MAX(total_orders) FROM store_totals)
ORDER BY store_id
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           co.country_name AS country,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           t.calendar_year AS year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS sales_amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, co.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT target.month,
           ROUND(AVG(
               ((y2020.sales_amount - y2019.sales_amount) / NULLIF(y2019.sales_amount, 0)
                * y2020.sales_amount + y2020.sales_amount) * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1)
           ), 2) AS average_projected_sales_usd
    FROM monthly_sales AS target
    JOIN monthly_sales AS y2019
      ON y2019.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND y2019.country = target.country
     AND y2019.month = target.month
     AND y2019.year = 2019
    JOIN monthly_sales AS y2020
      ON y2020.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND y2020.country = target.country
     AND y2020.month = target.month
     AND y2020.year = 2020
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
      ON fx.country = target.country
     AND fx.year = target.year
     AND fx.month = target.month
    WHERE target.year = 2021
    GROUP BY target.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT average_projected_sales_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_projected_sales_usd) AS position,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS month_count
    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE average_projected_sales_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(average_projected_sales_usd) AS median_monthly_average_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE position IN ((month_count + 1) / 2, (month_count + 2) / 2)
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT target.month,
           ROUND(AVG(
               (
                   (recent.amount - prior.amount) / NULLIF(prior.amount, 0)
                   * recent.amount + recent.amount
               ) * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)
           ), 2) AS average_projected_sales_usd
    FROM product_month_sales AS target
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS prior
      ON prior.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND prior.month = target.month
     AND prior.sales_year = 2019
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS recent
      ON recent.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND recent.month = target.month
     AND recent.sales_year = 2020
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
      ON fx.country = 'France'
     AND fx.year = target.sales_year
     AND fx.month = target.month
    WHERE target.sales_year = 2021
    GROUP BY target.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT average_projected_sales_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_projected_sales_usd) AS month_rank,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS month_count
    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE average_projected_sales_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(average_projected_sales_usd) AS median_average_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE month_rank IN ((month_count + 1) / 2, (month_count + 2) / 2)
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.prod_id,
        co.country_name,
        t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
        t.calendar_month_number AS month,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS monthly_sales
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, co.country_name, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
product_month_history AS (
    SELECT
        prod_id,
        country_name,
        month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) AS sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) AS sales_2020
    FROM product_month_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, country_name, month
    HAVING MAX(sales_year) = 2021
),
projections AS (
    SELECT
        country_name,
        month,
        sales_2020 + (sales_2020 - sales_2019) / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0) * sales_2020
            AS projected_sales
    FROM product_month_history
)
SELECT
    p.month,
    ROUND(AVG(p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1)), 2) AS avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM projections AS p
LEFT JOIN main.currency AS c
    ON c.country = p.country_name
   AND c.year = 2021
   AND c.month = p.month
GROUP BY p.month
ORDER BY p.month
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS sales_amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
projected_sales AS (
    SELECT current_sales.month,
           ((current_sales.sales_amount - prior_sales.sales_amount)
            / NULLIF(prior_sales.sales_amount, 0))
            * current_sales.sales_amount + current_sales.sales_amount AS projected_amount
    FROM monthly_sales AS current_sales
    JOIN monthly_sales AS prior_sales
      ON prior_sales.prod_id = current_sales.prod_id
     AND prior_sales.month = current_sales.month
     AND prior_sales.sales_year = 2019
    WHERE current_sales.sales_year = 2020
)
SELECT ps.month,
       ROUND(AVG(ps.projected_amount * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)), 2)
           AS avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM projected_sales AS ps
LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
  ON fx.country = 'France'
 AND fx.year = 2021
 AND fx.month = ps.month
GROUP BY ps.month
ORDER BY ps.month
LIMIT 12

Final SQL / answer

WITH RECURSIVE salary_characters (location, company_name, remaining_text, digits) AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, Salary, ''
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT location,
           company_name,
           SUBSTR(remaining_text, 2),
           digits || CASE
               WHEN SUBSTR(remaining_text, 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9]'
               THEN SUBSTR(remaining_text, 1, 1)
               ELSE ''
           END
    FROM salary_characters
    WHERE remaining_text <> ''
),
cleaned_salaries AS (
    SELECT location, company_name, CAST(digits AS REAL) AS salary_amount
    FROM salary_characters
    WHERE remaining_text = '' AND digits <> ''
),
country_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS average_salary
    FROM cleaned_salaries
),
company_location_averages AS (
    SELECT location, company_name, AVG(salary_amount) AS average_salary
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
      AND company_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY location, company_name
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT location,
           company_name,
           average_salary,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY location
               ORDER BY average_salary DESC, company_name
           ) AS location_rank
    FROM company_location_averages
)
SELECT r.location AS "Location",
       r.company_name AS "Company Name",
       r.average_salary AS "Average Salary in State",
       c.average_salary AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies AS r
CROSS JOIN country_average AS c
WHERE r.location_rank <= 5
ORDER BY r.location, r.location_rank
LIMIT 20

Final SQL / answer

WITH RECURSIVE salary_digits(Location, CompanyName, remaining_text, digits) AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, Salary, ''
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        substr(remaining_text, 2),
        digits || CASE
            WHEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9]'
                THEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text <> ''
),
cleaned_salaries AS (
    -- Average the stored amounts after stripping currency and pay-period text.
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, CAST(digits AS REAL) AS salary_amount
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text = '' AND digits <> ''
),
city_company_averages AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, AVG(salary_amount) AS city_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        city_average,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Location
            ORDER BY city_average DESC, CompanyName
        ) AS city_rank
    FROM city_company_averages
),
national_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS country_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
)
SELECT
    ranked_companies.Location AS "Location",
    ranked_companies.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
    ranked_companies.city_average AS "Average Salary in State",
    national_average.country_average AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies
CROSS JOIN national_average
WHERE ranked_companies.city_rank <= 5
ORDER BY ranked_companies.Location, ranked_companies.city_rank
LIMIT 20

Final SQL / answer

WITH order_demand AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS ordered_qty
    FROM main.orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 421
    GROUP BY product_id
),
stock_by_purchase_date AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.purchased, SUM(i.qty) AS stocked_qty
    FROM main.inventory_with_dims AS i
    JOIN order_demand AS d ON d.product_id = i.product_id
    GROUP BY i.product_id, i.purchased
),
fifo_stock AS (
    SELECT product_id, purchased,
           COALESCE(SUM(stocked_qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY product_id
               ORDER BY purchased
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ), 0) AS older_stock_qty
    FROM stock_by_purchase_date
)
SELECT pl.product_id, AVG(pl.qty) AS avg_units_picked
FROM main.picking_line AS pl
JOIN order_demand AS d ON d.product_id = pl.product_id
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.inventory_with_dims AS i
      JOIN fifo_stock AS f
        ON f.product_id = i.product_id AND f.purchased = i.purchased
      WHERE i.product_id = pl.product_id
        AND i.location_id = pl.location_id
        AND f.older_stock_qty < d.ordered_qty
  )
GROUP BY pl.product_id
ORDER BY pl.product_id
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    AVG(pl.qty) AS average_units_picked
FROM main.picking_line AS pl
JOIN main.products AS p ON p.id = pl.product_id
-- The recorded picks for this order follow FIFO by purchase batch.
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id
LIMIT 1000

  "question": "Identify the L1_model associated with each model (specified by name and version) that occurs most frequently for each status ('strong' or 'soft'), along with the number of times it occurs. A model has a 'strong' status if, for any of its steps, the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models is less than the 'Stack' model's test score. It has a 'soft' status if the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models equals the 'Stack' model's test score. Count how many times each L1_model is associated with a 'strong' or 'soft' status across all models, and determine which L1_model has the highest occurrence for each status.",

Final SQL / answer

WITH step_scores AS (
    SELECT name,
           version,
           step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS best_non_stack_score
    FROM main.model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.name,
           m.version,
           m.L1_model,
           CASE
               WHEN s.stack_score > s.best_non_stack_score THEN 'strong'
               WHEN s.stack_score = s.best_non_stack_score THEN 'soft'
           END AS status
    FROM step_scores AS s
    JOIN main.model AS m
      ON m.name = s.name AND m.version = s.version AND m.step = s.step
    WHERE s.stack_score >= s.best_non_stack_score
),
status_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM model_statuses
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT status,
           L1_model,
           occurrence_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC) AS status_rank
    FROM status_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count
FROM ranked
WHERE status_rank = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH model_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model, status
    FROM main.stack_ok
    WHERE status IN ('strong', 'soft')
),
status_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM model_statuses
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC) AS status_rank
    FROM status_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count
FROM ranked_counts
WHERE status_rank = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model
LIMIT -1

  "question": "Please calculate the fatality rate for motorcycle collisions, separated by helmet usage. Specifically, calculate two percentages: 1) the percentage of motorcyclist fatalities in collisions where parties (drivers or passengers) were wearing helmets, and 2) the percentage of motorcyclist fatalities in collisions where parties were not wearing helmets. For each group, compute this by dividing the total number of motorcyclist fatalities by the total number of collisions involving that group. Use the parties table to determine helmet usage (from party_safety_equipment fields).",

Final SQL / answer

WITH helmet_status_by_collision AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1), 0)
        AS helmet_used_fatality_percentage,
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1), 0)
        AS helmet_not_used_fatality_percentage
FROM helmet_status_by_collision
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH collision_helmet_use AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct
FROM collision_helmet_use
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, p.driver_id, p.constructor_id
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS p ON p.race_id = r.race_id
),
driver_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id
    FROM appearances
),
missed_races AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        MIN(r.round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(r.round) AS last_missed_round
    FROM driver_years AS d
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a
        ON a.year = d.year
        AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id
        AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
)
SELECT
    AVG(m.first_missed_round) AS avg_first_round,
    AVG(m.last_missed_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM missed_races AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM appearances AS before_miss
    JOIN appearances AS after_miss
        ON after_miss.year = before_miss.year
        AND after_miss.driver_id = before_miss.driver_id
        AND after_miss.round = m.last_missed_round + 1
        AND after_miss.constructor_id <> before_miss.constructor_id
    WHERE before_miss.year = m.year
      AND before_miss.driver_id = m.driver_id
      AND before_miss.round = m.first_missed_round - 1
)
LIMIT 1

WITH recorded_races AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round
    FROM main.races AS r
    WHERE r.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM main.results)
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, s.driver_id, s.constructor_id
    FROM recorded_races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
),
driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id
    FROM appearances
),
missed_rounds AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id,
           MIN(r.round) AS first_missed_round,
           MAX(r.round) AS last_missed_round
    FROM driver_seasons AS d
    JOIN recorded_races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a
      ON a.year = d.year
     AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id
     AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
),
team_changes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.year, m.driver_id, m.first_missed_round, m.last_missed_round
    FROM missed_rounds AS m
    JOIN appearances AS before_gap
      ON before_gap.year = m.year
     AND before_gap.driver_id = m.driver_id
     AND before_gap.round = m.first_missed_round - 1
    JOIN appearances AS after_gap
      ON after_gap.year = m.year
     AND after_gap.driver_id = m.driver_id
     AND after_gap.round = m.last_missed_round + 1
    WHERE before_gap.constructor_id <> after_gap.constructor_id
)
SELECT AVG(first_missed_round) AS avg_first_missed_round,
       AVG(last_missed_round) AS avg_last_missed_round
FROM team_changes
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH line_demand AS (
    SELECT ol.id AS order_line_id,
           ol.product_id,
           ol.qty,
           SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.product_id
               ORDER BY ol.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS demand_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
),
warehouse_stock AS (
    SELECT i.product_id,
           l.aisle,
           l.position,
           i.qty,
           SUM(i.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY i.product_id
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS stock_end
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.locations AS l ON l.id = i.location_id
    JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
      AND i.qty > 0
      AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM line_demand)
)
SELECT d.order_line_id,
       d.product_id,
       s.aisle,
       s.position,
       SUM(
           MIN(d.demand_end, s.stock_end)
           - MAX(d.demand_end - d.qty, s.stock_end - s.qty)
       ) AS qty_to_pick
FROM line_demand AS d
JOIN warehouse_stock AS s
  ON s.product_id = d.product_id
 AND s.stock_end > d.demand_end - d.qty
 AND d.demand_end > s.stock_end - s.qty
WHERE d.qty > 0
GROUP BY d.order_line_id, d.product_id, s.aisle, s.position
ORDER BY d.order_line_id, MIN(s.stock_end - s.qty), s.aisle, s.position
LIMIT 1000

      "sql": "WITH demand AS (\n    SELECT ol.product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(ol.qty) AS ordered_qty,\n           MIN(ol.qty) AS smallest_line, GROUP_CONCAT(ol.id || '=' || ol.qty) AS order_lines\n    FROM main.orderlines AS ol\n    WHERE ol.order_id = 423\n    GROUP BY ol.product_id\n), stock AS (\n    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS inventory_qty, MIN(i.qty) AS smallest_lot,\n           MIN(p.purchased) AS first_purchase, MAX(p.purchased) AS last_purchase,\n           SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL OR p.product_id <> i.product_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_issues\n    FROM main.inventory AS i\n    JOIN main.locations AS l ON l.id = i.location_id\n    LEFT JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id\n    WHERE l.warehouse = 1\n    GROUP BY i.product_id\n)\nSELECT d.*, s.inventory_qty, s.smallest_lot, s.first_purchase, s.last_purchase, s.purchase_issues\nFROM demand AS d\nLEFT JOIN stock AS s ON s.product_id = d.product_id\nORDER BY d.product_id"

Final SQL / answer

WITH order_demand AS (
    SELECT ol.id AS order_line_id,
           ol.product_id,
           ol.qty,
           SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.product_id
               ORDER BY ol.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS demand_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
),
warehouse_stock AS (
    SELECT i.product_id,
           l.aisle,
           l.position,
           i.qty,
           SUM(i.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY i.product_id
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS stock_end
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.locations AS l ON l.id = i.location_id
    JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
      AND i.qty > 0
      AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_demand)
)
SELECT d.order_line_id,
       d.product_id,
       s.aisle,
       s.position,
       SUM(
           MIN(d.demand_end, s.stock_end)
           - MAX(d.demand_end - d.qty, s.stock_end - s.qty)
       ) AS pick_qty
FROM order_demand AS d
JOIN warehouse_stock AS s
    ON s.product_id = d.product_id
   AND s.stock_end - s.qty < d.demand_end
   AND d.demand_end - d.qty < s.stock_end
WHERE d.qty > 0
GROUP BY d.order_line_id, d.product_id, s.aisle, s.position
ORDER BY d.order_line_id, MIN(s.stock_end)
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT total_quantity_sold,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC, product
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity_sold) AS overall_avg_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1000

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT total_quantity_sold,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC, product
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity_sold) AS overall_avg_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH RECURSIVE daily_changes AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        t.txn_date AS balance_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE -t.txn_amount END) AS net_change
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS t
    GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.txn_date
),
customer_starts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(balance_date) AS first_date
    FROM daily_changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- Carry balances forward through the last date in the transaction data.
calendar(balance_date) AS (
    SELECT MIN(balance_date) FROM daily_changes
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(balance_date, '+1 day')
    FROM calendar
    WHERE balance_date < (SELECT MAX(balance_date) FROM daily_changes)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        c.balance_date,
        strftime('%Y-%m', s.first_date) AS baseline_month,
        SUM(COALESCE(d.net_change, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.customer_id
            ORDER BY c.balance_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS balance
    FROM customer_starts AS s
    JOIN calendar AS c ON c.balance_date >= s.first_date
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes AS d
        ON d.customer_id = s.customer_id AND d.balance_date = c.balance_date
),
rolling_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', balance_date) AS month,
        baseline_month,
        AVG(balance) OVER last_30_days AS average_balance,
        COUNT(*) OVER last_30_days AS days_in_window
    FROM daily_balances
    WINDOW last_30_days AS (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY balance_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
),
customer_monthly_maxima AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month, MAX(MAX(average_balance, 0.0)) AS maximum_average_balance
    FROM rolling_balances
    WHERE days_in_window = 30 AND month > baseline_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT month, SUM(maximum_average_balance) AS total_max_30_day_average_balance
FROM customer_monthly_maxima
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH RECURSIVE
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date AS balance_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_change
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
reporting_end AS (
    SELECT MAX(balance_date) AS last_day
    FROM daily_changes
),
customer_days(customer_id, balance_date, baseline_month, last_day) AS (
    SELECT
        d.customer_id,
        MIN(d.balance_date),
        strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(d.balance_date)),
        r.last_day
    FROM daily_changes AS d
    CROSS JOIN reporting_end AS r
    GROUP BY d.customer_id, r.last_day

    UNION ALL

    SELECT customer_id, date(balance_date, '+1 day'), baseline_month, last_day
    FROM customer_days
    WHERE balance_date < last_day
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.balance_date,
        c.baseline_month,
        SUM(COALESCE(d.net_change, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.customer_id
            ORDER BY c.balance_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_balance
    FROM customer_days AS c
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes AS d
        ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
       AND d.balance_date = c.balance_date
),
rolling_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', balance_date) AS month,
        baseline_month,
        COUNT(*) OVER trailing_days AS days_in_window,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER trailing_days AS average_balance
    FROM daily_balances
    WINDOW trailing_days AS (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY balance_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
),
customer_monthly_maxima AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month,
        MAX(MAX(average_balance, 0.0)) AS max_30_day_average_balance
    FROM rolling_balances
    WHERE days_in_window = 30
      AND month > baseline_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT
    month,
    SUM(max_30_day_average_balance) AS total_max_30_day_average_balance
FROM customer_monthly_maxima
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH delivered_seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_reviews_by_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_totals AS (
    SELECT d.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(d.order_profit) AS total_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS distinct_orders,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.review_count, 0)) AS five_star_ratings
    FROM delivered_seller_orders AS d
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_reviews_by_order AS r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category, 'Most distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
           seller_id, distinct_customers AS value
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest profit', seller_id, total_profit
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, distinct_orders
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, five_star_ratings
    FROM seller_totals
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, achievement, seller_id, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category ORDER BY value DESC, seller_id
           ) AS seller_rank
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE seller_rank = 1
ORDER BY category
LIMIT 4

Final SQL / answer

WITH seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_reviews AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS rating_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT so.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
           ROUND(SUM(so.order_profit), 2) AS profit,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0)) AS five_star_count
    FROM seller_orders AS so
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = so.order_id
    GROUP BY so.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category_order, 'Most distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
           seller_id, customer_count AS value
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest total profit', seller_id, profit
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, order_count
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, five_star_count
    FROM seller_metrics
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category_order, achievement, seller_id, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category_order
               ORDER BY value DESC, seller_id
           ) AS position
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY category_order
LIMIT 4

Final SQL / answer

WITH reference_date(as_of) AS (
    SELECT date('now', '+09:00')
),
user_ages AS (
    SELECT
        u.user_id,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', r.as_of) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', u.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', r.as_of) < strftime('%m-%d', u.birth_date)) AS age
    FROM main.mst_users AS u
    CROSS JOIN reference_date AS r
),
age_categories(category_order, age_category) AS (
    VALUES (2, '20s'), (3, '30s'), (4, '40s'), (5, '50s'), (6, 'others')
)
SELECT
    c.age_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS user_count
FROM age_categories AS c
LEFT JOIN user_ages AS u
    ON c.category_order = CASE
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 20 AND 59 THEN u.age / 10
        ELSE 6
    END
GROUP BY c.category_order, c.age_category
ORDER BY c.category_order
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id,
           m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           CASE
               WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS points
    FROM main."Match" AS m

    UNION ALL

    SELECT m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id,
           m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           CASE
               WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS points
    FROM main."Match" AS m
),
team_season_points AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id,
           SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id, total_points,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS season_rank
    FROM team_season_points
)
SELECT r.season,
       t.team_long_name AS team_name,
       l.name AS league,
       c.name AS country,
       r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.season_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, t.team_long_name, l.name, c.name
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        home_team_goal AS goals_for,
        away_team_goal AS goals_against
    FROM main."Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        away_team_api_id,
        away_team_goal,
        home_team_goal
    FROM main."Match"
),
season_points AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN goals_for > goals_against THEN 3
            WHEN goals_for = goals_against THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS total_points
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY season
            ORDER BY total_points DESC
        ) AS points_rank
    FROM season_points
)
SELECT
    r.season,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.points_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, team_name, league, country
LIMIT 1000

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        date(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE txn_type
            WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
        END) AS monthly_net
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
closing_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY month_start
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
ranked_balances AS (
    SELECT
        closing_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance, 1, 0) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start
        ) AS previous_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC
        ) AS month_rank
    FROM closing_balances
),
latest_growth AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN previous_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - previous_balance) * 100.0 / previous_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM ranked_balances
    WHERE month_rank = 1
)
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE growth_rate > 5) / COUNT(*)
    AS percentage_of_customers
FROM latest_growth
LIMIT 1

Final SQL / answer

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT
        tx.customer_id,
        DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE tx.txn_type
            WHEN 'deposit' THEN tx.txn_amount
            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -tx.txn_amount
        END) AS net_amount
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx
    WHERE tx.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month')
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY month_start
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS closing_balance,
        net_amount
    FROM monthly_net
),
latest_balances AS (
    SELECT
        closing_balance,
        closing_balance - net_amount AS prior_month_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC
        ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_balances
),
customer_growth AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN prior_month_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - prior_month_balance) * 100.0 / prior_month_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM latest_balances
    WHERE month_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM customer_growth
LIMIT 1

      "sql": "WITH monthly_net AS (\n    SELECT\n        tx.customer_id,\n        DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,\n        SUM(CASE tx.txn_type\n            WHEN 'deposit' THEN tx.txn_amount\n            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -tx.txn_amount\n        END) AS net_amount\n    FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx\n    WHERE tx.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')\n    GROUP BY tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month')\n),\nmonthly_balances AS (\n    SELECT\n        customer_id,\n        month_start,\n        SUM(net_amount) OVER (\n            PARTITION BY customer_id\n            ORDER BY month_start\n            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW\n        ) AS closing_balance,\n        net_amount\n    FROM monthly_net\n),\nlatest_balances AS (\n    SELECT\n        closing_balance,\n        closing_balance - net_amount AS prior_month_balance,\n        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC\n        ) AS month_rank\n    FROM monthly_balances\n),\ncustomer_growth AS (\n    SELECT\n        CASE\n            WHEN prior_month_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0\n            ELSE (closing_balance - prior_month_balance) * 100.0 / prior_month_balance\n        END AS growth_rate\n    FROM latest_balances\n    WHERE month_rank = 1\n)\nSELECT\n    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 END)\n        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_of_customers\nFROM customer_growth\nLIMIT 1",

    "arguments": {
      "sql": "WITH last_round AS (\n    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS round\n    FROM main.races AS r\n    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.driver_standings AS d WHERE d.race_id = r.race_id)\n    GROUP BY year\n),\nstanding_totals AS (\n    SELECT r.year, d.driver_id, d.points\n    FROM main.driver_standings AS d\n    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = d.race_id\n    JOIN last_round AS lr ON lr.year = r.year AND lr.round = r.round\n),\nrace_totals AS (\n    SELECT r.year, x.driver_id, SUM(x.points) AS points\n    FROM main.results AS x\n    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = x.race_id\n    GROUP BY r.year, x.driver_id\n),\nstanding_ranked AS (\n    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY points DESC) AS point_rank\n    FROM standing_totals\n),\nrace_ranked AS (\n    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY points DESC) AS point_rank\n    FROM race_totals\n)\nSELECT s.year, sd.full_name AS standings_name, s.points AS standings_points,\n       rd.full_name AS result_name, r.points AS result_points\nFROM standing_ranked AS s\nJOIN race_ranked AS r ON r.year = s.year\nJOIN main.drivers AS sd ON sd.driver_id = s.driver_id\nJOIN main.drivers AS rd ON rd.driver_id = r.driver_id\nWHERE s.point_rank = 1 AND r.point_rank = 1 AND s.driver_id <> r.driver_id\nORDER BY s.year",

Final SQL / answer

WITH order_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        ol.id AS order_line_id,
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty AS required_qty,
        SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ol.product_id
            ORDER BY o.ordered, o.id, ol.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS order_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    JOIN main.orders AS o ON o.id = ol.order_id
),
inventory_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.qty AS available_qty,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.product_id
            ORDER BY pu.purchased, i.qty, i.location_id, i.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS inventory_end
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.purchases AS pu ON pu.id = i.purchase_id
),
order_picks AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_line_id,
        o.product_id,
        o.required_qty,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                MIN(o.order_end, i.inventory_end)
                - MAX(o.order_end - o.required_qty, i.inventory_end - i.available_qty)
            ),
            0
        ) AS picked_qty
    FROM order_ranges AS o
    LEFT JOIN inventory_ranges AS i
        ON i.product_id = o.product_id
        AND i.inventory_end > o.order_end - o.required_qty
        AND o.order_end > i.inventory_end - i.available_qty
    GROUP BY o.order_line_id, o.product_id, o.required_qty
)
SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    AVG(100.0 * op.picked_qty / NULLIF(op.required_qty, 0)) AS avg_pick_percentage
FROM order_picks AS op
JOIN main.products AS p ON p.id = op.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT -1

Final SQL / answer

WITH page_views AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, path
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
),
session_bounds AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM page_views
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT
    views.path,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN views.stamp IN (bounds.first_stamp, bounds.last_stamp)
        THEN views.session
    END) AS session_count
FROM page_views AS views
JOIN session_bounds AS bounds ON bounds.session = views.session
WHERE views.path <> ''
GROUP BY views.path
ORDER BY views.path
LIMIT -1

WITH date_differences AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER) AS years,
        CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER) AS months,
        CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER) AS days
    FROM main.player
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(
    ROUND(ABS(years), 2)
    + ROUND(ABS(months) / 12.0, 2)
    + ROUND(ABS(days) / 365.0, 2)
), 2) AS average_career_span_years
FROM date_differences
LIMIT 1
